inclusion_rules: advertises test/sandbox mode OR free self-serve tier supporting a reversible effect (from public docs only)
self-serve signup without enterprise sales contract
supports a journey object meeting effect requirements per public docs
not FIRSTCALL-authored and not a prior FIRSTCALL target with known outcome
exclusion_rules: no safe test/sandbox capability per public docs
requires real money/PII/irreversible effect with no sandbox
region-locked or KYC-gated beyond a sandbox
duplicate platform of an already-included vendor
prior FIRSTCALL experimental target (Postmark, Resend, CF-001/Acme, MULTI-002 Stripe) to prevent outcome leakage
ordering: within each category sort by hash(vendor_name + RANDOMISATION_SEED); take top m per category to reach N
enterprise_only_or_no_sandbox: excluded at frame stage by rule; if drawn due to ambiguous metadata => INELIGIBLE_PRE_EXECUTION and replaced by next-in-order in same category

replacements.source: next vendor in the same category's frozen ordering

sample_size.rationale: >=6 categories x ~4 vendors; vendor-level Wilson half-width ~0.10-0.12 mid-range; N is the precision driver at the unit of inference

anti_cherry_pick: frame+seed+algorithm+full ordered draw+reserves hashed and frozen before any run
blind_safeguard: draw + hash now; plaintext vendor list revealed only inside sealed pre-registration bundle at Freeze 5; no operability inspection before protocol freeze
